references.text: Moses' staff is mentioned here for the first time, where God asks what he has in his hand
Moses took God's staff in his hand when he returned to Egypt
The staff was used as a sign before Pharaoh when it turned into a snake
The staff was used to strike the Nile and turn the water into blood
The staff was stretched out over the rivers to bring about the plague of frogs
Aaron struck the dust with the staff and brought about the plague of gnats
Moses stretched out his hand toward heaven with the staff and brought about hail and fire
Moses stretched out the staff over Egypt and brought about the plague of locusts
Moses was told to lift up the staff and part the sea
God commanded Moses to take the staff and strike the rock to bring forth water
Moses used the staff at Meribah when he struck the rock for water
Direct narrative continuation: 4:4 shows the staff turning into a snake, while 4:17 instructs to use this staff for several signs.
